## Hassfest translation compatibility

This patch release keeps the SparkyFitness synchronization introduced in
`v0.6.0` and fixes Home Assistant Hassfest validation for the new setup text.

- Removed the literal example URL from the SparkyFitness base-address field
  description, as Home Assistant requires URLs in translations to use
  placeholders.
- Kept the English and Russian setup descriptions aligned.
- No runtime, queue, API mapping, ESPHome component, or transport behavior has
  changed.
